task:
Open the Obsidian vault at /home/user/Documents/RecipeVault. Create a recipe collection:

1. Create folders: 'Italian', 'Asian', 'Desserts'.
2. Create 'Italian/Carbonara.md' with frontmatter 'cuisine: italian', 'servings: 4', 'time: 30' and body containing heading 'Carbonara', ingredient list, instructions, a link to [[Cacio e Pepe]], and tags #recipe #italian #pasta
3. Create 'Italian/Cacio e Pepe.md' with frontmatter 'cuisine: italian', 'servings: 2', 'time: 20' and body containing heading, ingredients, instructions, a link to [[Carbonara]], and tags #recipe #italian #pasta
4. Create 'Asian/PadThai.md' with frontmatter 'cuisine: thai', 'servings: 2', 'time: 25' and body containing heading, ingredients, instructions, and tags #recipe #thai #noodles
5. Create 'Desserts/Tiramisu.md' with frontmatter 'cuisine: italian', 'servings: 6', 'time: 45' and body containing heading, ingredients, instructions, a link to [[Carbonara]], and tags #recipe #italian #dessert
6. Create 'Index.md' in root with body containing heading 'Recipe Index', links to [[Carbonara]], [[Cacio e Pepe]], [[PadThai]], [[Tiramisu]], and tags #index #recipes

verification.description: Carbonara links to Cacio e Pepe
Cacio e Pepe links to Carbonara
